title: NeuFin Decision Assurance Envelope
description: NeuFin's Decision Assurance Envelope specification (v1) — a machine-readable structure for representing a single proposed financial decision, the investor and portfolio context behind it, and the human-review disposition that resolves it. This is a NeuFin specification, not an industry, regulatory, or official standard.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific proposed decision.

trace_id.description: Identifier linking this decision to a broader workflow or conversation trace, for cross-system correlation.

organization_id.description: Identifier for the organization (advisory firm, platform, or enterprise tenant) this decision was evaluated within.

investor_id.description: Identifier for the specific investor this decision concerns.

actor_id.description: Identifier for the human actor (advisor, ops user) associated with this decision, when applicable.

agent_id.description: Identifier for the AI agent associated with this decision, when applicable.

actor_or_agent.description: Identity of whoever proposed this decision.

mandate.description: What the actor or agent is actually authorized to do for this investor.

investor_context.description: What is known about the investor relevant to this decision.

portfolio_context.description: The current, relevant state of the investor's holdings.

proposed_action.description: The specific action being proposed for review.

suitability.description: Result of comparing the proposed action to the investor's stated mandate and risk profile.

policy.description: Result of comparing the proposed action to firm-level or configured policy constraints.

evidence.description: The traceable basis for this decision.

confidence.description: System-assigned confidence score for this decision, 0 to 1.

human_approval.description: Record of human review, when the disposition requires or received one.

disposition.description: The resolved outcome of this decision. PROCEED, REVIEW, ESCALATE, and DENY are the business dispositions defined by this specification. Technical systems may separately represent NOT_EVALUATED where a check could not be completed, outside this enum.
